title: PSYCHEDELIC YOGA In-Person Workshop!
description:
**January 4, 4:00-6:00pm at Daya Yoga, Brooklyn**
*Only $20 for a unique, two-hour workshop!*

REGISTER HERE: [https://dayayoga.studiogrowth.com/class/385605](https://dayayoga.studiogrowth.com/class/385605)

This workshop introduces **[Psychedelic Yoga](https://dayayoga.studiogrowth.com/class/385605)**, a collection of practices to cultivate non-ordinary states of consciousness to support **healing, spiritual exploration, and creative flow**. Each practice in Psychedelic Yoga can be applied to everyday life.

We'll journey through **gentle postures** that open energetic pathways, **breathwork** that can shift consciousness as powerfully as any substance, and **sound healing with live didgeridoo** vibrations that create resonance in the body's energy centers.

Drawing from **Tibetan Dream Yoga**, we'll practice meditations that reveal the dream-like nature of all experience. We'll explore our senses mindfully—savoring **grapes** as a gateway to presence, and for the adventuresome, experiencing **nail boards** as a practice in working skillfully with intense feelings.

**Optional high-quality cannabis edibles will be offered for FREE.**

Everyone is welcome, from beginners wanting a unique and deeply relaxing experience to yoga teachers, therapists, and psychedelic journeyers seeking new methods. The practices are designed to calm the mind and reduce suffering, bringing us closer to our natural state of awareness and joy.

*[Come learn and practice Psychedelic Yoga with us!](https://dayayoga.studiogrowth.com/class/385605)*
ai_summary: In-person Psychedelic Yoga workshop for beginners and practitioners; learn gentle postures, breathwork, and sound healing to calm the mind and reduce suffering.
host_bio:
**Henry Kandel** designs events that combine many different forms of yoga, intentional psychedelic use, healing and creative flow.  They've taught asana, pranayama, and meditation for psychedelic experience, and have run dozens of workshops integrating cannabis.  They pioneered Ketamine-State Yoga, and have taught it to therapists, yogis, and hundreds of folks online.

They have taught math and science at Saint Ann’s School for 30 years.  They designed and taught original courses in Physics, Astronomy and Game Theory, as well as electives such as “The Sci of Sci-Fi,” “Science of Music,” and, “Dream, Sleep, and Consciousness.”

They've practiced many forms of yoga over the same time period, focusing on pranayama and Tibetan Dream Yoga.  Psychedelics, combined with yogic practice, have brought them vast spiritual and mental-health benefits.

title: Full Moon Meditation
description:
Join us for a transformative evening with the energy of the full moon — a powerful time for meditation and reflection.

Meditating during a full moon can help shift negative emotions and patterns into a more positive space, offering a profound sense of renewal. It also enhances mental clarity making it an ideal time to realign, refocus, and find inner balance.

Meditating in a group is a transformative practice that helps us connect deeply with our essence. When we gather with a shared intention, the collective energy amplifies serenity and peace, uplifting everyone present.

Don't miss this chance to reconnect with your inner self and the energy of the full moon.

BENEFITS YOU WILL EXPERIENCE
-> Heightened self-awareness & emotional release
-> Powerful manifestation of personal intentions
-> Deep inner peace & relaxation
ai_summary: Group full-moon meditation for anyone seeking reflection and renewal; outcome: deeper inner peace.

title: Museum Visit
description:
As of 1/22/2026:
The weather service has said there will be a blizzard! I sure hope everyone can still make it next week! I have updated the event to 2/1.

Hi Everyone! 👋🏾👋🏾

Our last event was a doozy! 🥴

Let's talk about the next one! 📓 🖊️

Our next museum is a first for our group! We're going to the American Museum of Natural History, one of the absolute best museums in NYC! Established in 1869, AMNH has a lovely gem and mineral collection, dinosaur bones, a library, fantastic animal specimens and more! 🦕

We will not be able to see everything in one day, so we can absolutely plan to come back. I booked 30 tickets. In order to stay with the group it is important that you come on time! It may be very difficult to find us after we go in. 🦖

NYS residents can always book their own tickets with the pay as you wish option online.

You don't want to miss this! Hope to see you there! 🎨🖼️🗽
